description_en: Retrieves the download URL for the ringback tone recording
description_zh: 获取响铃放音的录音下载链接
name: GetTotalPublicUrl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to verify the binding relationship. Valid values:

true: The binding relationship is verified.

false: The binding relationship is not verified
parameters.help_zh:
是否需要校验绑定关系标识。
取值：

true：需要校验。

false：不需要校验
parameters.name: check_subs

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

You can obtain the number pool key on the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool) page in the Phone Number Privacy Protection console
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool)页面获取号码池Key
parameters.name: partner_key

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the call record, which is used to identify a call record.

You can obtain the ID by using one of the following methods:
Go to the Call Record Query (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call) page in the console to query and obtain the call record ID.
View the call_id field in the recording status report receipt message
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫记录ID，用于标识一条通话记录。

获取方式如下：
在控制台呼叫记录查询 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call)页面进行查询，获取呼叫记录ID。
在录音状态报告回执消息中查看call_id字段
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en:
The time when the call was initiated in the call record.

You can obtain the time by using one of the following methods:

Go to the Call Record Query (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call) page in the console to query and obtain the call initiation time in the Call Time column.
View the call_time field in the recording status report receipt message.

CallTime does not support parameters in the timestamp format
parameters.help_zh:
呼叫记录中的呼叫发起时间。

获取方式如下：

在控制台呼叫记录查询 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/call)页面进行查询，获取呼叫时间列的呼叫发起时间。
在录音状态报告回执消息中查看call_time字段。

CallTime不支持传入时间戳格式的参数
parameters.name: call_time
